summaries.text: This resolution recognizes and thanks Mae Krier on her 100th birthday for her contributions to the United States as a trailblazer and a Rosie the Riveter (a term used to describe women who joined the workforce during World War II).

title: Recognizing the role of Mae Krier and her contributions as she celebrates her 100th birthday.
